title: FERC OKs Penalty-free Exits for 2022 MISO Queue Cycle, Restudy Cap

meta.summary:
MISO is free to offer a one-time, penalty-free exit for 2022 interconnection queue projects while capping late-stage restudies, FERC ruled. 
 The post  FERC OKs Penalty-free Exits for 2022 MISO Queue Cycle, Restudy Cap  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
